findings.namedBuyers: Alexandra Martiné, Director of BD & Operations, Geneva / Western Switzerland, is the strongest local operational and business-development contact. Xi Zhang, CEO and Founder, is a senior strategic escalation contact. Jackie Raïssa Galbert supports community development and customer integration and is an additional member-needs referral candidate. These are verified commercially relevant people, NOT verified hotel buyers; no hotel contracting authority is established.
findings.futureEdition: No exact published Geneva activity date found within 8 December 2026–30 June 2028. Next dated FONGIT Café+Croissant found: 1 December 2026, 09:30–11:30, B4 Campus Biotech, Rue Kazem-Radjavi 5, 1202 Genève; this is upcoming as of 17 November but OUTSIDE the requested horizon. Superlab’s Geneva afterwork listing and Demo Day page do not establish a qualifying future calendar date. No next in-horizon edition announced in reviewed sources. Do not use article publication dates as activity dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Conditional inference using the supplied hotel specifications: YOTEL Geneva Lake’s 237 rooms and six meeting rooms could support a separately identified visiting project/training team or modest off-site meeting, but there is no evidenced overnight group or room-block size to quote. Founex is not Geneva city; no source establishes Superlab visitors lodging toward La Côte, flying through Geneva Airport, or accepting this commute. Existing on-site meeting room, discussion room and community space reduce the case for routine outsourced meetings. The documented coffee/networking and 09:00–12:00 Demo Day formats do not establish overnight need. This is not an evidenced resort-retreat opportunity or primary housing mandate. Catering capacity remains unverified from the hotel brief.
findings.venueCommitments: Established project location: Superlab Suisse Geneva SA, B4 building, Campus Biotech, Chemin des Mines 9, 1202 Genève, Geneva city, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Not Founex/Nyon/La Côte or the Geneva Airport corridor. The dated FONGIT event specifies B4 at Rue Kazem-Radjavi 5, another published address at the campus; use its event-specific entrance rather than silently substituting the Superlab postal address. Existing operational premises are evidenced; no future hotel or meeting-venue procurement commitment is published.
findings.historicalRotation: This is a permanent lab-network expansion, not a demonstrated rotating congress. A Geneva preview was advertised for 30 October 2025 at Campus Biotech. The company’s June 2025 release targeted January 2026 move-in; Campus Biotech later stated May 2026, and FONGIT’s 17 September 2026 event explicitly said the Geneva offices/labs had launched as of May. Exact opening day remains unpublished. Lausanne, Basel and Zurich are other operating sites, not evidence of venue rotation.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No official housing bureau, hotel room block, host hotel, hotel RFP, named accommodation buyer, or edition-specific hotel commitment was found in the reviewed Geneva location, contact and event materials. Hotels listed for this Geneva activity: none found. This is not evidence that rooms are open for sale or that private arrangements do not exist. The location offer is “Move into a fully serviced lab inside Campus Biotech”, not accommodation. The events page instead says: “We encourage you to come by public transport (Tram 15, stop: Maison de la Paix).” Event registration is not a hotel-booking pathway.
findings.organizationStructure: Superlab Suisse is a corporate lab-as-a-service/workspace operator, founded in Zurich in 2019; the Geneva entity is Superlab Suisse Geneva SA. It is not presented as an association, PCO, DMC or hotel operator. Campus Biotech is the premises/ecosystem; FONGIT is a distinct programme collaborator, not interchangeable with the project owner. Who pays for any individual tenant or visitor accommodation is unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No incumbent hotel, room block, hotel exclusivity, sold-out condition or overflow requirement is evidenced. Do not claim a competitor displacement opportunity. The concrete competing meeting option is Superlab’s own shared meeting/community facilities and Campus Biotech’s meeting infrastructure, not a competing hotel. The site’s 750+ life-science-company ecosystem claim is not event attendance, hotel demand or peak rooms.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First approach Alexandra Martiné through the published Geneva business channel, Geneva@superlabsuisse.com / +41 78 950 95 00. Ask whether any non-resident tenant onboarding, vendor installation, scientific training or visiting project team has exact dates between 8 December 2026 and June 2028; who chooses and pays for rooms; whether bookings are independent or centrally contracted; and whether Founex transport is acceptable. Request an introduction to the actual tenant/travel buyer only if relevant demand exists. Then offer a small pilot lodging/off-site meeting proposal sized to verified needs, within the supplied roughly 20–120-room group guidance, not the entire hotel. Use Xi Zhang for strategic escalation, not an assumed hotel RFP. Keep the lead in nurture until dated activity and sourcing access are established.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Not currently sales-qualified for the requested horizon. The published 1 December 2026 FONGIT session has registration closing 27 November 2026 at 10:00 and requires registration; this is programme access, not accommodation access. The January/May 2026 facility launch is historical, not an upcoming mobilisation. No in-horizon date or independently bookable lodging is verified.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Relationship-development inference only: FONGIT explicitly describes Café+Croissant as monthly, and Superlab advertises Geneva community events, but recurrence does not establish future dates, fixed Superlab hosting, annual rotation or recurring hotel demand. A future non-resident tenant/vendor/scientific training team might create a separate hotel lead if dates, payer and transport are confirmed. Do not classify this as confirmed upcoming business or recurring competitive capture.
